long_how_credit_scores_quietly_determine.title: How Credit Scores Quietly Determine Your Financial Options

scenes.label: Numerical Expression
scenes.line: A credit score is a numerical expression derived from an analysis of an individual credit history and credit report. Lenders use credit scores to evaluate the risk of lending money to consumers.
scenes.image_prompt: A modern computer screen displaying graphs and financial data, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Financial Obligations
scenes.line: It is used to estimate the relative likelihood that the individual will repay debts and meet other financial obligations. Credit scoring serves as a primary alternative to traditional forms of loan underwriting, enabling faster and more consistent credit decisions.
scenes.image_prompt: A calculator resting on top of a signed contract, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Free Report
scenes.line: Under the Dodd-Frank Act passed in 2010, a consumer is entitled to receive a free report of the specific credit score used if they are denied a loan, credit card or insurance. The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau estimates that approximately 26 million Americans have no credit record with any of the three major credit bureaus.
scenes.image_prompt: A printed official government financial document on a desk, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Thin Records
scenes.line: An additional 19 million have records too thin or too stale to generate a score. Together these groups represent roughly 45 million adults who may be unable to access conventional credit products or qualify for loans on standard terms.
scenes.image_prompt: Old paper files stored inside metal filing cabinet drawers, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Demographic Impact
scenes.line: Credit invisibility disproportionately affects younger adults, Black and Hispanic consumers, and people in low-income neighborhoods. Before credit scores, credit was evaluated using credit reports from credit bureaus.
scenes.image_prompt: Busy pedestrians walking along a city sidewalk, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Computerized Scoring
scenes.line: During the late 1950s, banks started using computerized credit scoring to redefine creditworthiness as abstract statistical risk. The Equal Credit Opportunity Act banned denying credit on gender or marital status in 1974, along with race, nationality, religion, age, or receipt of public assistance in 1976.
scenes.image_prompt: Early mainframe computer equipment inside a brightly lit room, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Lawsuit Shield
scenes.line: Credit scoring adoption accelerated to shield against discrimination lawsuits. During the 1970s and 80s, the credit reporting industry relentlessly consolidated and moved aggressively into prescreening.
scenes.image_prompt: A set of heavy law books resting on a wooden shelf, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Mortgage Application
scenes.line: The FICO score burst into public consciousness in 1995 when Freddie Mac had lenders use credit scoring for all new mortgage applications. Modern credit scoring models date to 1958, when Bill Fair and Earl Isaac created Credit Application Scoring Algorithms, their first credit scoring system.
scenes.image_prompt: A suburban residential house viewed from the street, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: FICO Introduction
scenes.line: The FICO score was first introduced in 1989 by FICO, then called Fair, Isaac, and Company. The FICO model is used by the vast majority of banks and credit grantors, and is based on consumer credit files of the three national credit bureaus: Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.
scenes.image_prompt: The exterior of a corporate office building, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Bureau Variations
scenes.line: Because a consumer credit file may contain different information at each of the companies, FICO scores can vary depending on which bureau provides the information. Credit scores are designed to measure the risk of default by taking into account various factors in a person financial history.
scenes.image_prompt: Three separate computer monitors displaying different financial charts, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Secret Formulas
scenes.line: Although the exact formulas for calculating credit scores are secret, FICO has disclosed the following components. Payment history accounts for 35 percent and is best described as the presence or lack of derogatory information.
scenes.image_prompt: A closed vintage metal safe with a combination dial, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Negative Events
scenes.line: Bankruptcy, settlements, charge-offs, repossessions, foreclosures, and late payments can cause a FICO score to drop. Debt burden accounts for 30 percent and considers a number of debt-specific measurements.
scenes.image_prompt: A stack of overdue utility bills and envelopes on a counter, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Debt Metrics
scenes.line: According to FICO there are six different metrics in the debt category including the debt to limit ratio and number of accounts with balances. Length of credit history or time in file accounts for 15 percent.
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of a hand holding a modern smartphone, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: History Aging
scenes.line: As a credit history ages it can have a positive impact on its FICO score. There are several metrics in this category, most significantly the average age of the accounts on a report and the age of the oldest account.
scenes.image_prompt: A mature tree standing in a park during autumn, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Credit Types
scenes.line: Types of credit used accounts for 10 percent. Consumers can benefit by having a history of managing different types of credit.
scenes.image_prompt: A collection of different plastic credit and debit cards, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Recent Searches
scenes.line: Recent searches for credit account for 10 percent. Hard credit inquiries or hard pulls occur when consumers apply for a credit card or loan.
scenes.image_prompt: A person typing a search query on a laptop keyboard, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Inquiry Impact
scenes.line: Hard inquiries can hurt scores, especially if done in great numbers. Individuals who are rate shopping for a mortgage, auto loan, or student loan over a short period will likely not experience a meaningful decrease in their scores.
scenes.image_prompt: A red warning icon displayed on a digital dashboard, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Inquiry Grouping
scenes.line: The FICO scoring model considers all of those types of hard inquiries that occur within 14 or 45 days of each other as only one. Mortgage, auto, and student loan inquiries do not count at all in a FICO score if they are less than 30 days old.
scenes.image_prompt: A grouping of multiple file folders on a desk, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Display Period
scenes.line: All credit inquiries are recorded and displayed on personal credit reports for two years. They have no effect after the first year because FICO scoring system ignores them after 12 months.
scenes.image_prompt: A printed financial report showing historical data entries, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Soft Inquiries
scenes.line: Credit inquiries made by the consumer, by an employer, or by companies initiating pre-screened offers are called soft inquiries or soft pulls. Soft inquiries do not have any impact on a credit score and do not appear on a credit report used by lenders.
scenes.image_prompt: An unopened envelope sitting on a wooden hallway table, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Population Makeup
scenes.line: These percentages are based on the importance of the five categories for the general population. For particular groups, such as people who have not been using credit long, the relative importance of these categories may be different.
scenes.image_prompt: A diverse crowd of people walking down a busy city street, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Past Behavior
scenes.line: The makeup factors are limited to the individual past and continuing behavior on credit. Contrary to common misconception, other financial factors such as age, employment status, assets, or income are not accounted.
scenes.image_prompt: A person writing notes inside a small pocket notebook, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Lender Discretion
scenes.line: However, lenders are not prohibited from asking about and accounting these factors for particular lending considerations. Getting a higher credit limit can help a credit score.
scenes.image_prompt: A bank loan officer speaking across a meeting table, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Utilization Ratio
scenes.line: The higher the credit limit on the credit card, the lower the utilization ratio average for all of a borrower credit card accounts. The utilization ratio is the amount owed divided by the amount extended by the creditor.
scenes.image_prompt: A digital bar chart showing decreasing levels, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Court Judgments
scenes.line: Any money owed because of a court judgment or tax lien carries an additional penalty, especially when recent. Having one or more newly opened consumer finance credit accounts may also be a negative.
scenes.image_prompt: A wooden gavel resting on a matching sound block, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Score Range
scenes.line: The classic FICO credit score is between 300 and 850. 1.2 percent of Americans held the highest FICO score of 850 in 2019.
scenes.image_prompt: A gauge instrument showing a needle pointing upward, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: National Bureaus
scenes.line: Each individual actually has over 60 credit scores for the FICO scoring model, as each of the three national credit bureaus has its own database, but the most used are 40. Data about an individual consumer can vary from bureau to bureau.
scenes.image_prompt: An office interior with computer servers and data processing equipment representing national credit bureaus., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Score Names
scenes.line: FICO scores have different names at each of the different credit reporting agencies: Equifax, TransUnion, and Experian. Equifax uses Beacon, TransUnion uses FICO Risk Score Classic, and Experian uses the Experian FICO Risk Model.
scenes.image_prompt: A modern corporate office lobby with three separate reception desks., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Active Generations
scenes.line: There are several active generations of FICO credit scores including FICO 98, FICO 04, FICO 8, FICO 9, FICO 10, and FICO 10T. A new type of FICO score named UltraFICO score was released in 2019.
scenes.image_prompt: A timeline chart displayed on a glass wall in a financial institution., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Inactive Scores
scenes.line: The FICO 95 credit score released in 1995 and Equifax FICO 98 scores are no longer in use. The Experian FICO 98 score is named FICO Score 2, and Experian FICO 04 score is FICO Score 3.
scenes.image_prompt: Old computer hardware stored neatly on metal shelving in a warehouse., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: TransUnion Renaming
scenes.line: TransUnion FICO 04 score is FICO Score 4, and Equifax FICO 04 score is FICO Score 5. The FICO Score XD is made with alternative data and was released in 2016.
scenes.image_prompt: A calculator and financial documents spread out on a clean workspace., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Mortgage Lenders
scenes.line: Mortgage lenders use EX FICO Score 2, EQ FICO Score 5 and TU FICO Score 4, but not a real FICO Mortgage Score. Consumers can buy their FICO scores plus credit report for Equifax, TransUnion, and Experian from the FICO website.
scenes.image_prompt: A desk with house keys resting on top of real estate loan paperwork., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Score Variety
scenes.line: They will get their FICO score 8, FICO Bankcard Score 8, FICO Auto Score 8, FICO Score 9, FICO Auto Score 9, and FICO Bankcard Score 9. Individuals can get up to 28 FICO scores on myFICO, consisting of 10 EX, 9 EQ, and 9 TU.
scenes.image_prompt: A stack of various consumer financial statements on a desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Experian Basic
scenes.line: Anyone can register and get their free EX FICO score 8 with Experian CreditWorks Basic. The FICO NextGen Risk Score is a scoring model designed by the FICO company for assessing consumer credit risk.
scenes.image_prompt: A person tapping a registration button on a digital tablet screen., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: NextGen Generations
scenes.line: This score was introduced in 2001, and in 2003 the second generation of NextGen was released. In 2004, FICO research showed a 4.4% increase in the number of accounts above cutoff compared to FICO traditional.
scenes.image_prompt: An office calendar hanging on a wall next to a window., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: NextGen Range
scenes.line: FICO NextGen score is between 150 and 950. Each of the major credit agencies markets this score generated with their data differently.
scenes.image_prompt: A digital meter graphic showing a numerical scale from 150 to 950., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: SBSS Score
scenes.line: The FICO Small Business Scoring Service score is used to evaluate small business credit applicants. This score can evaluate the personal credit report of a business owner along with the business credit report of the business itself.
scenes.image_prompt: A small business owner reviewing financial ledgers at a wooden desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: SBSS Range
scenes.line: The score range for the FICO SBSS score is 0 to 300, and a higher score indicates less risk. Applications for SBA 7(a) loans for $350,000 or less will be prescreened using this score.
scenes.image_prompt: A risk assessment gauge pointing toward a favorable green zone., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: VantageScore Intro
scenes.line: In 2006, the three major credit-reporting agencies introduced VantageScore credit score to try to win business away from FICO. According to court documents filed in the FICO v. VantageScore federal lawsuit, the VantageScore market share was less than 6% in 2006.
scenes.image_prompt: Corporate buildings in a financial district under an overcast sky., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: VantageScore Range
scenes.line: The VantageScore methodology initially produced a score range from 501 to 990. VantageScore 3.0 score adopted the score range of 300 to 850 in 2013.
scenes.image_prompt: An older computer terminal displaying a software numeric range., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: VantageScore 4.0
scenes.line: The VantageScore 4.0 score was released in mid-2017 and also uses a range of 300 to 850. Consumers can get free VantageScores from free credit report websites and from credit cards issued by major banks.
scenes.image_prompt: A software developer looking at code on a dual monitor workstation., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Vantage Tiers
scenes.line: The VantageScore 3.0 and 4.0 lower than 550 is very poor, 550 to 649 is poor, and 650 to 699 is fair. Vantage scores from 700 to 749 are good, and 750 to 850 are excellent.
scenes.image_prompt: A credit scoring tier chart printed on a laminated reference sheet., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Synchrony Usage
scenes.line: As of 2024, Synchrony Bank uses VantageScore 4.0 as the credit score for granting its credit cards. In July 2025, the Federal Housing Finance Agency announced that Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac will permit lenders to use VantageScore 4.0.
scenes.image_prompt: A plastic credit card resting on top of a retail purchase receipt., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: CE Score
scenes.line: CE Score is published by CE Analytics and is distributed to 6,500 lenders through the Credit Plus network with a range of 350 to 850. A number of scores have been developed to help consumers understand and improve their credit scores before FICO shared details.
scenes.image_prompt: A network server rack blinking with blue indicator lights in a data center., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: FAKO Scores
scenes.line: Discussions on the myFICO forum and elsewhere have referred to non-FICO scores as FAKO scores. Experian has the Plus Score between 330 and 830, and Experian's National Equivalence Score ranges from 360 to 840.
scenes.image_prompt: An online forum discussion board displayed on a computer screen., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Equifax Score
scenes.line: Equifax has the Equifax Credit Score of between 280 and 850. CreditXpert offers a simulation score to estimate the impact of various actions on a score range of 350 to 850.
scenes.image_prompt: A computer displaying a consumer credit summary report., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Alternative Data Usage
scenes.line: Lenders may choose to use non-FICO credit scores to gain additional insight on consumers with limited traditional credit history. Most of these scores are based significantly on data not available through the national credit bureaus.
scenes.image_prompt: A loan officer reviewing a non-traditional applicant file folder., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Credit Optics
scenes.line: The Credit Optics Score by SageStream blends traditional and alternative credit data with machine learning and ranges from 1 to 999. LexisNexis RiskView score, based on wide-ranging public records, ranges from 501 to 900.
scenes.image_prompt: Machine learning code and data curves displayed on a computer monitor., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: CoreLogic
scenes.line: CoreLogic Credco reports on property related public records and its Anthem Credit Score ranges from 325 to 850. PRBC allows consumers to self-enroll and report their own non-debt payment history with a range of 100 to 850.
scenes.image_prompt: Property deed documents and land survey maps resting on a desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: ChexSystems
scenes.line: There are also scores like ChexSystems Consumer Score designed for financial account verification services ranging from 100 to 899. Scorelogix LLC offers the JSS Credit Score, which assesses credit risk based on job history, income, and the impact of the economy.
scenes.image_prompt: A bank teller assisting a customer across a service counter., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Behavioral Risk
scenes.line: A Behavioral Risk Score from 0 to 999 is used by Comenity Bank and Comenity Capital Bank. TU CreditVision Scores and TU New Account score ranging from 300 to 850 are issued by TransUnion and used by WebBank.
scenes.image_prompt: A corporate banking office interior with minimalist desk setups., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Credit Builder
scenes.line: Credit builder loans offered by credit unions hold loan proceeds in a locked savings account while the borrower makes monthly payments. Since the mid-2010s, financial technology companies have offered comparable products through mobile applications without a membership requirement.
scenes.image_prompt: A traditional credit union building facade with glass doors., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Product Structure Mechanics
scenes.line: Product structure determines which scoring components are affected by reporting different types of consumer financial activity. Installment products report only installment activity and so build payment history alone without other categories.
scenes.image_prompt: A modern computer screen displaying financial graphs and data analysis charts., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Revolving Product Balances
scenes.line: Revolving products report a balance against a credit limit and therefore also generate a credit utilization ratio. The credit utilization ratio generated by revolving products forms a part of the debt burden category.
scenes.image_prompt: A credit card lying on top of printed bank statements in an office setting., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Rent and Bill Reporting
scenes.line: Rent and bill reporting adds existing recurring payments to a file rather than creating a new obligation. The effect of rent and bill reporting is limited by the specific scoring model evaluating the file.
scenes.image_prompt: A person reviewing monthly utility bills and rental payment receipts at home., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: VantageScore and FICO
scenes.line: VantageScore 4.0 and FICO 10T consider rent and utility payments while classic FICO scores do not. Classic FICO scores long used in mortgage underwriting do not consider rent and utility payments.
scenes.image_prompt: A computer monitor displaying comparative charts of different scoring algorithms., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Bureau Reach Issues
scenes.line: The effect is also limited by whether the payments reach the bureaus at all during the process. Payments reaching the bureaus was the case for about 13 percent of consumers in 2025.
scenes.image_prompt: A server room with glowing lights representing data transmission and network activity., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: CFPB Randomized Trial
scenes.line: In a randomized controlled trial of 1,531 credit union members commissioned by the CFPB, participants were evaluated. The randomized controlled trial was conducted by the RAND Corporation for the regulatory agency.
scenes.image_prompt: A researcher reviewing demographic data and clinical trial statistics on a laptop., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Credit Builder Loan Impact
scenes.line: Participants without existing debt saw modest score gains while those already carrying debt saw slight declines. Borrowers carrying existing debt became more likely to miss payments on their other loans during the trial.
scenes.image_prompt: A financial report highlighting contrasting upward and downward trend lines., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Late Payment Rates
scenes.line: Nearly 40 percent of borrowers made at least one late payment on the credit builder loan itself. As a result of the FACT Act, each legal U.S. resident is entitled to a free copy of their credit report.
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of a hand holding a pen over a payment ledger., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Agency Report Frequency
scenes.line: Residents are entitled to a free copy of their credit report from each credit reporting agency once every twelve months. The law requires all three agencies, Equifax, Experian, and Transunion, to provide reports to consumers.
scenes.image_prompt: A calendar hanging on a wall showing monthly intervals., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Absence of Credit Scores
scenes.line: These credit reports do not contain credit scores from any of the three credit reporting agencies. The three credit bureaus run Annualcreditreport.com, where users can get their free credit reports.
scenes.image_prompt: A printed financial report page showing detailed text without any numerical score., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Add-On Credit Scores
scenes.line: Non-FICO credit scores are available as an add-on feature of the report for a fee. This fee is usually $7.95, as the FTC regulates this charge through the Fair Credit Reporting Act.
scenes.image_prompt: A digital checkout screen displaying an additional item charge., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: FTC Tracking Scams
scenes.line: The FTC tracks various scams and reports on other sites that provide fake credit reports. Instances of illegal behaviors by credit report services have been settled in court across the country.
scenes.image_prompt: A computer screen displaying cybersecurity warning alerts and data protection notices., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Experian Consumer Direct
scenes.line: Experian Consumer Direct was charged with deceptively signing people up for credit report monitoring services. The monitoring services charged consumers monthly fees through deceptive enrollment practices.
scenes.image_prompt: A corporate office building exterior with glass windows reflecting the sky., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Insurance Price Determination
scenes.line: Credit scores are often used in determining prices for auto and homeowner's insurance policies. Starting in the 1990s, national credit reporting agencies began generating more specialized insurance scores.
scenes.image_prompt: An insurance policy document lying next to a set of car keys on a table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Insurance Risk Rating
scenes.line: Insurance companies use specialized scores to rate the insurance risk of potential customers. Studies indicate that the majority of those who are insured pay less in insurance through the use of scores.
scenes.image_prompt: An insurance agent reviewing risk assessment tables on a computer screen., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Claims Frequency Data
scenes.line: Studies point out that people with higher scores have fewer claims filed against their policies. In 2009, TransUnion representatives testified before the Connecticut legislature about marketing credit score reports.
scenes.image_prompt: A clipboard holding an insurance claim form and a pen on a desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Employer Hiring Use
scenes.line: TransUnion marketed credit score reports to employers for use in the hiring process. Legislators in at least twelve states introduced bills to limit the use of credit checks during hiring.
scenes.image_prompt: A desk with a resume, a notepad, and a professional pen ready for review., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Passed State Laws
scenes.line: Three states have passed laws to limit the use of credit checks during the hiring process. Credit scoring systems have garnered considerable criticism from various media outlets and debtors unions.
scenes.image_prompt: A state capitol building dome viewed against a clear daytime sky., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Consumer Law Concerns
scenes.line: Consumer law organizations and government officials raised concerns regarding the scoring system. Discrimination against prospective employees and rejection of rental applications are concerns raised.
scenes.image_prompt: Law books and legal briefs arranged neatly on a library bookshelf., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Racial Bias Concerns
scenes.line: Racial bias, poor risk prediction, manipulation of algorithms, and overall immorality are concerns. The scoring system has been studied as a form of classification to shape an individual's life-chances.
scenes.image_prompt: Abstract representation of digital code and complex algorithmic flowcharts on a screen., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Social Services Loss
scenes.line: The classification scheme is necessitated by the loss of collective social services and risk. The credit scoring system in the United States is similar to the Social Credit System in China.
scenes.image_prompt: An empty municipal office waiting room with closed service windows., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Basic Functions Criticism
scenes.line: Obtaining and maintaining employment, housing, transport, and insurance are basic functions of participation. Auto insurance and other basic needs are in some cases mandated by law for modern society.
scenes.image_prompt: A busy city street showing cars, pedestrians, and residential buildings in daylight., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: CFPB Deceit Charges
scenes.line: The CFPB charged Equifax and TransUnion with deliberate deceit of consumers about credit score values. Agencies were caught providing different scores to consumers than what was being provided to lenders.
scenes.image_prompt: A government regulatory notice document resting on an office desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Trial Service Fees
scenes.line: Agencies were charged with deceit by charging recurring fees to those enrolled in trial services. The credit reporting agencies were required to pay $23 million in fines and restitution.
scenes.image_prompt: A bank statement showing recurring monthly deductions highlighted in red marker., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Data Breach Settlement
scenes.line: Equifax agreed to a settlement of $575 million with authorities related to a data breach. The data breach occurred in 2017 where 147 million people were affected by exposed information.
scenes.image_prompt: A secure server rack in a data center with indicator lights flashing., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Astonishing Fact
scenes.line: One of the earliest documented inflations occurred in Alexander the Great's empire 330 BC. How does an increase in the general price level reduce the purchasing power of money?

scenes.line: Germany was the first country to introduce retirement benefits in 1889. Nowadays, most developed countries have systems to provide pensions on retirement in old age, funded by employers or the state.
scenes.image_prompt: Old European cobblestone street with traditional architecture., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: US Private Plans
scenes.line: Only about 15% of private industry workers in the US had access to a traditional defined benefit pension plan as of March 2023. These plans are increasingly rare, as most companies now offer defined contribution plans like 401(k)s instead.
scenes.image_prompt: A modern financial chart displayed on a computer screen., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Public Sector
scenes.line: Public sector workers have much higher pension coverage, with about 75% participating in pension plans. In many poorer countries, there is no support for the elderly beyond that provided through the family.
scenes.image_prompt: A government administration building with columns at the entrance., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Rights in Society
scenes.line: Today, retirement with a pension is considered a right of the worker in many societies. Hard ideological, social, cultural and political battles have been fought over whether this is a right.
scenes.image_prompt: A courthouse entrance with stone steps and pillars., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Constitutional Right
scenes.line: In many Western countries, this is a right embodied in national constitutions. An increasing number of individuals choose or are forced to put off this point of total retirement and exist in the emerging state of pre-tirement.
scenes.image_prompt: A framed document hanging on a wood-paneled wall., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Eighteenth Century
scenes.line: Retirement has been around since around the 18th century. Countries began to adopt government policies on retirement during the late 19th century, beginning in Germany under Otto von Bismarck.
scenes.image_prompt: An antique globe resting on a wooden desk next to a quill., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Retirement Age
scenes.line: A person may retire at whatever age they please. However, a country's tax laws or state old-age pension rules usually mean that a certain age is thought of as the standard retirement age.
scenes.image_prompt: A calendar hanging on a wall with circled dates., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Increasing Age
scenes.line: As life expectancy increases, in many countries the retirement age at which the public pension is awarded has been increased in the 21st century. The standard retirement age varies from country to country but it is generally between 50 and 70 according to latest statistics, 2011.
scenes.image_prompt: A line graph showing an upward trend on a digital tablet., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Gender Differences
scenes.line: In some countries this age is different for men and women. This has recently been challenged in some countries, for example, Austria.
scenes.image_prompt: Two empty chairs facing opposite directions in a bright room., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Increasing Timeline
scenes.line: The retirement age in many countries is increasing, often starting in the 2010s and continuing until the late 2020s. In Denmark, early retirement is called efterløn and there are some requirements such as contributing to the labor market for at least 20 years.
scenes.image_prompt: A modern wristwatch resting on a glass surface., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: France Changes
scenes.line: In France, the retirement age was 60, with full pension entitlement at 65; in 2010 this was extended. In Spain it was ruled that the retirement age was to increase from 65 to 67 progressively from 2013 to 2027.
scenes.image_prompt: A Parisian street view with classic apartment buildings., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: United States OASI
scenes.line: In the United States, the normal retirement age for Social Security, or Old Age Survivors Insurance, was age 65 to receive unreduced benefits. It is gradually increasing to age 67 by 2027.
scenes.image_prompt: An official government building facade with American architecture., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Police Officers
scenes.line: Police officers in the United States may typically retire at half pay after 20 years of service. They can retire at three-quarter pay after 30 years, allowing retirement from the early forties.
scenes.image_prompt: A police vehicle parked outside a station on a city street., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Military Armed Forces
scenes.line: Military members of the US Armed Forces may elect to retire after 20 years of active duty. Iranian age of retirement was increased much in 2022 and 2023 to 42 years of work insurance payment record to avoid government social security bankruptcy.
scenes.image_prompt: An American flag standing upright in an empty conference room., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Data Advances
scenes.line: Recent advances in data collection have vastly improved the ability to understand important relationships between retirement and factors like health and wealth. The most prominent study for examining retirement behavior in the United States is the ongoing Health and Retirement Study, first fielded in 1992.
scenes.image_prompt: A computer monitor displaying rows of data analytics spreadsheets., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: HRS Demographics
scenes.line: The HRS is a nationally representative longitudinal survey of adults in the U.S. ages 51+, conducted every two years. 2002 and 2004 saw the introductions of ELSA and SHARE, which includes respondents from 14 continental European countries plus Israel.
scenes.image_prompt: A modern laptop open on a wooden table in a well-lit room., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Global Surveys
scenes.line: A number of other countries like Japan and South Korea also now field HRS-like surveys. Retirement funding education is a big factor that affects the success of an individual's retirement experience.
scenes.image_prompt: A commuter train arriving at a station platform in a large city., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Trust Funds
scenes.line: Social Security plays an important role because most individuals solely rely on Social Security, when trust funds are expected to be depleted by 2034. Knowledge affects retirement decisions by finding reliable options such as Individual Retirement Accounts or Employer-Sponsored Plans.
scenes.image_prompt: A closed vault door inside a secure financial institution., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Incentives
scenes.line: People are much more likely to retire at the early and normal retirement ages of the public pension system like ages 62 and 65 in the U.S. Greater wealth tends to lead to earlier retirement since wealthier individuals can essentially purchase additional leisure.
scenes.image_prompt: A numerical keypad on a secure office door., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Inheritance Impact
scenes.line: Receiving an inheritance increases the probability of retiring earlier than expected by 4.4 percentage points over an eight-year period. A great deal of attention has surrounded how the 2008 financial crisis and subsequent Great Recession are affecting retirement decisions.
scenes.image_prompt: A set of old brass keys resting on a wooden tabletop., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Stock Exposure
scenes.line: Those nearing retirement had only limited exposure to the recent stock market decline and thus are not likely to substantially delay their retirement. Mass layoffs are likely to lead to an increase in retirement almost 50% larger than the decrease brought about by the stock market crash.
scenes.image_prompt: A quiet suburban house exterior viewed from the sidewalk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Career Shifts
scenes.line: Many who retire will continue to work, but not in the career they have had for the majority of their life. Alba-Ramirez uses micro data from the Active Population Survey of Spain and logit model for analyzing determinants of retirement decision.
scenes.image_prompt: A person holding gardening tools in a backyard garden., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Household Size
scenes.line: Having more members in the household, and as well as children, has a negative effect on the probability of retirement among older males. Males in bigger households with children have to earn more and pension benefits will be less than needed for household.
scenes.image_prompt: A family gathered around a dining room table having a meal., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Health Impact
scenes.line: Antolin and Scarpetta using German Socio-Economic Panel and hazard model find that socio-demographic factors such as health and gender have a strong impact. Women tend to retire earlier than men, and poor health makes people go into retirement, particularly in the case of disability retirement.
scenes.image_prompt: A medical professional reviewing health charts on a digital tablet., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Chronic Conditions
scenes.line: Blau and Riphahn using individual data from the German Socio-Economic Panel found that if an individual has a chronic health condition, then he tends to retire. Antolin and Scarpetta use better measures for health status than Blau and Riphahn because self-assessed and objective indicators are better measures.
scenes.image_prompt: A stethoscope and medical records resting on a clean white desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: OECD Sample
scenes.line: Blöndal and Scarpetta find significant effect of socio-demographic factors on the retirement decision across the OECD. Men tend to retire later than women as women try to benefit from special early retirement schemes in Germany and the Netherlands.
scenes.image_prompt: A cityscape viewed through a large office window during the morning., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Entitlement Age
scenes.line: Women get access to pensions earlier than men as standard age of entitlement to pension is lower for women compared with men in Italy and the United Kingdom. Heads of large households prefer not to retire because of the significance of wages in large households compared with smaller ones.
scenes.image_prompt: An old historic clock mounted on a stone building wall outdoors., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Disability Scheme
scenes.line: Poor health conditions are especially significant if respondents join to disability benefit scheme. Murray et al. have shown that in the United Kingdom local labour markets of where workers live affects later life work exit.
scenes.image_prompt: A medical consultation room with chairs and medical examination equipment., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Older Workers
scenes.line: Older workers aged 50 to 75 were more likely to exit the workforce over 10 years if they had lived in a more deprived local authority. For respondents that identified as sick or disabled, effects of local area unemployment were stronger for respondents who had better self-rated health.
scenes.image_prompt: An older worker standing near the entrance of a warehouse facility., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Birth Cohort
scenes.line: The second study used the 1946 Birth Cohort to show that area unemployment near retirement age is not the only factor that matters. Higher area unemployment at age 26 was associated with poorer health and lower likelihood of employment at aged 53.
scenes.image_prompt: A stack of historical archive files placed neatly on a metal shelf., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Key Mediators
scenes.line: Health and employment status were identified as the key mediators between area unemployment and retirement age. Rashad Mehbaliyev analyzed how different factors related with health, demographics, behavior, financial status, and macroeconomics affect retirement status.
scenes.image_prompt: A medical scale and a health record folder on a wooden table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: New Members
scenes.line: Males are less likely to be retired compared with females in New Member States, which is the opposite result than he found for Old Member States. Significant gender wage gap exists in New Member States and household sizes are bigger in these countries.
scenes.image_prompt: Modern apartment buildings under a clear blue sky in an eastern city., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Quinn Study
scenes.line: Quinn et al. find significant correlation between health status and retirement status among survey respondents. They transform answers for question about health status from five levels into three levels and report results for three groups.
scenes.image_prompt: A researcher analyzing statistical survey results on a computer monitor., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Excellent Health
scenes.line: 85% of respondents who answered excellent or very good to the question about their health were still working two years after this interview. 73% of people from the first group were still on the job market in 1996, while this is 66% and 55% for other groups.
scenes.image_prompt: An active person jogging along a paved pathway in a city park., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Opposite Effect
scenes.line: Dhaval, Rashad and Spasojevic show that relationship between retirement and health status can imply the opposite effect in reality. Benitez-Silva analyzes determinants of labor force status and retirement process among elderly US citizens using logit and probit models.
scenes.image_prompt: A stethoscope resting on top of a medical textbook in a library., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Insurance Impact
scenes.line: Being insured has a negative effect on switching job status from not employed to employed for people aged 60 to 62. Income after retirement can come from state pensions, occupational pensions, private savings and investments, donations, and social benefits.
scenes.image_prompt: An insurance policy document lying flat on a wooden office desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Plan Types
scenes.line: Pension plans can be categorized as funded or pay-as-you-go. Provision of pay-as-you-go state pensions can be a significant drain on a government's budget, leading to pension underfunding.
scenes.image_prompt: A flowchart diagram drawn on a glass whiteboard with a marker., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Health Care Costs
scenes.line: Older people are more prone to sickness, and the cost of health care in retirement is large. Most countries provide universal health insurance coverage for seniors, although in the United States many people retire before Medicare at 65.
scenes.image_prompt: A pharmacy counter with medicine bottles and prescription containers., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Lump Sum Formula
scenes.line: For funded pensions, the ideal lump sum available at retirement uses the standard mathematical formula for the sum of a geometric series. Assume that S equals 60,000 per year and that it is desired to replace 80% of pre-retirement living standard for 30 years.
scenes.image_prompt: A handwritten mathematical formula written on a black chalkboard., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Savings Proportion
scenes.line: Assume for current purposes that a proportion of pay equal to 0.25 was being saved. Using a 2% per year real return on investments, the necessary lump sum is given by the formula.
scenes.image_prompt: A handful of metal coins placed neatly beside a savings ledger., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Currency Terms
scenes.line: The calculation yields 806,272 in the nation's currency in 2008 to 2010 terms. To allow for inflation, it is best to talk of the 806,272 as being 13.43 years of retirement age salary.
scenes.image_prompt: A stack of currency notes tied with a paper band on a table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Non Housing
scenes.line: It is common to not include any house value in the calculation, so for a homeowner the lump sum pays primarily for non-housing living costs. At retirement, the accumulation matches with the lump sum needed to pay the pension.
scenes.image_prompt: A suburban residential house viewed from the front lawn area., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Savings Rate
scenes.line: Equation Ret-03 gives the answer for the proportion of pay that should be saved under this method. One might assume that price inflation will be 3.5% per year forever and that one's pay will increase only at that same rate.
scenes.image_prompt: An algebraic equation written clearly on a white presentation board., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Nominal Interest
scenes.line: If a 4.5% per year nominal rate of interest is assumed, pre-retirement and post-retirement net interest rates remain the same. The problem that the lifespan is not known in advance can be reduced by the purchase at retirement of an inflation-indexed life annuity.
scenes.image_prompt: A financial report document featuring percentage rates and tables., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Purchasing Power
scenes.line: Inflation-adjusted annuities are designed to provide income that rises with inflation, helping retirees maintain purchasing power over time. A useful calculation can be done if it is assumed that interest, after expenses, taxes, and inflation is zero.
scenes.image_prompt: A person holding shopping receipts while reviewing household accounts., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Salary Replacement
scenes.line: Assume that in real terms, one's salary never changes over working life. After working years, retirement age accumulated savings equal working years multiplied by the savings proportion.
scenes.image_prompt: An employment contract document laid out on an office desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Equate Savings
scenes.line: Equating working savings to pension needs yields the proportion Z that should be saved. For more complicated situations, there are several online retirement calculators on the Internet.
scenes.image_prompt: A balance scale sitting on a wooden table surface., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Monte Carlo
scenes.line: Monte Carlo retirement calculators take volatility into account and project the probability that a particular plan will outlast the retiree. The assumptions keyed into a retirement calculator are critical for determining future financial outcomes.
scenes.image_prompt: A computer monitor displaying statistical probability distribution curves., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Investment Return
scenes.line: One of the most important assumptions is the assumed rate of real investment return after inflation. A conservative return estimate could be based on the real yield of inflation-indexed bonds.
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of a calculator resting on top of printed financial graphs., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Global Governments
scenes.line: Such inflation-indexed bonds are offered by governments including the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. The TIP$TER retirement calculator projects retirement expenditures that a bond portfolio can sustain.
scenes.image_prompt: Flags of the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom displayed side by side., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Income Sources
scenes.line: Calculators combine bond portfolios with other income sources like Social Security. Current real yields on United States Treasury Inflation Protected Securities are available at the US Treasury site.
scenes.image_prompt: An official government envelope and documents resting on a home table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Real Return Bonds
scenes.line: Current real yields on Canadian Real Return Bonds are available at the Bank of Canada site. As of December 2011, US Treasury inflation-linked bonds were yielding about 0.8% real per annum.
scenes.image_prompt: An exterior view of a large bank building with classical stone pillars., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Thirty Year Maturity
scenes.line: The 0.8% real per annum yield applied to the 30-year maturity bonds. The 7-year maturity bonds yielded a noteworthy slightly negative real return.
scenes.image_prompt: A timeline graphic drawn on a whiteboard showing a thirty year span., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Internet Calculators
scenes.line: Many individuals use retirement calculators on the Internet to determine their savings proportion. Internet calculators help determine savings proportions for tax-advantaged plans.
scenes.image_prompt: A person browsing financial websites on a tablet device at home., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: US Plans
scenes.line: Examples of tax-advantaged plans in the US include the IRA or 401-K. An example of a tax-advantaged plan in Canada is the RRSP.
scenes.image_prompt: A retirement account statement showing investment fund allocations., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: UK Plans
scenes.line: An example of a tax-advantaged plan in the UK is the personal pension. An example of a tax-advantaged plan in Australia is superannuation.
scenes.image_prompt: A British pension fund statement opened on a wooden table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Zero Assumption
scenes.line: After expenses and taxes, a reasonable long-term assumption for a safe real rate of return is zero. In real terms, interest does not help the savings grow under a zero return assumption.
scenes.image_prompt: A blank notepad and a pen resting on a clean office desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Working Years
scenes.line: Each year of work must pay its share of a year of retirement. For someone planning to work for 40 years and be retired for 20 years, mathematics dictate savings shares.
scenes.image_prompt: A wall calendar with marked work days and retirement dates., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Equal Pay Shares
scenes.line: Each year of work pays for itself and for half a year of retirement. Hence, 33.33% of pay must be saved, and 66.67% can be spent when earned.
scenes.image_prompt: A division symbol drawn on a piece of paper with a pencil., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Accumulated Assets
scenes.line: After 40 years of saving 33.33% of pay, we have accumulated assets of 13.33 years of pay. In the graph, the lines are straight, which is appropriate given a zero real investment return.
scenes.image_prompt: A stack of coins growing taller beside a financial ledger., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Nominal Dollars
scenes.line: Most retirement calculators use nominal dollars and require inflation and return projections. One way to work around this limitation is to enter zero percent return and zero inflation inputs.
scenes.image_prompt: A calculator displaying currency numbers on an illuminated screen., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Bloomberg Calculator
scenes.line: The Bloomberg retirement calculator gives the flexibility to specify zero inflation and zero investment return. The MSN retirement calculator in 2011 has realistic 3% inflation and 8% return defaults.
scenes.image_prompt: A computer monitor displaying financial software with custom input fields., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Market Consistency
scenes.line: Market consistency requires a change to about 3% inflation and 4% investment return before and after retirement. Ignoring tax, someone wishing to work for a year and relax for a year needs to save 50% of pay.
scenes.image_prompt: A financial analyst reviewing market indices on a laptop screen., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Thirty Year Retirement
scenes.line: Someone wishing to work from age 25 to 55 and be retired for 30 years till 85 needs to save 50% of pay. The 50% savings rate assumes government and employment pensions are not a factor.
scenes.image_prompt: A timeline graphic highlighting the ages of twenty five, fifty five, and eighty five., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Monte Carlo Method
scenes.line: A newer method for determining the adequacy of a retirement plan is Monte Carlo simulation. This simulation method has been gaining popularity and is now employed by many financial planners.
scenes.image_prompt: A computer screen running a complex data simulation with moving probability curves., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Simulation Inputs
scenes.line: Monte Carlo calculators allow users to enter savings, income, and expense information. The simulation results show the probability that the retirement plan will be successful.
scenes.image_prompt: A person entering budget numbers into an online planning form., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Early Retirement Definition
scenes.line: Retirement is considered early if it occurs before the age needed for government or employer support. Early retirees typically rely on their own savings and investments to be self-supporting.
scenes.image_prompt: A person walking out of an office building carrying a box of personal items., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: External Support
scenes.line: Early retirees rely on savings indefinitely or until they begin receiving external support. Early retirement can also be a euphemistic term for being terminated from employment before typical age.
scenes.image_prompt: A savings account statement showing periodic disbursement transactions., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Withdrawal Rate
scenes.line: The withdrawal rate from the portfolio depends on the remaining life expectancy. Those contemplating early retirement will want to know if they have enough to survive possible bear markets.
scenes.image_prompt: A life expectancy mortality table printed on paper with a highlighter., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Four Percent Rule
scenes.line: One would need to live on about 4% of the initial portfolio per year to ensure funds are not depleted. This rule of thumb is a summary of one conclusion of the Trinity study.
scenes.image_prompt: A calculator showing the number four percent on its display screen., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Nuanced Report
scenes.line: The report is more nuanced and the conclusions and very approach have been heavily criticized. The 4% rule allows for increasing withdrawals with inflation to maintain consistent spending ability.
scenes.image_prompt: Notes written in the margins of a printed research document., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Prolonged Bear Markets
scenes.line: Withdrawals continue even in dramatic and prolonged bear markets under the 4% guideline. When retiring prior to age 59+1/2, there is a 10% IRS penalty on withdrawals from a 401(k) or IRA.
scenes.image_prompt: A stock market graph showing a sharp downward plunge followed by a flat line., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Penalty Exception
scenes.line: Exceptions apply under certain circumstances regarding early retirement plan withdrawals. At age 59 and six months, penalty-free status is achieved and the 10% IRS penalty no longer applies.
scenes.image_prompt: A legal tax code book opened to a page with highlighted exception clauses., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Rule Seventy Two T
scenes.line: To avoid the penalty prior to age 59+1/2, a person should consult a lawyer about IRS rule 72 T.
scenes.image_prompt: A legal consultation office with a law book and a pen on the desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

long_how_individual_retirement_accounts_.title: How Individual Retirement Accounts Grew Into Vital Financial Tools

scenes.label: Tax Advantages
scenes.line: An individual retirement account in the United States offers tax advantages for retirement savings. Many financial institutions offer this type of retirement savings plan.
scenes.image_prompt: A modern bank building exterior under clear daylight., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Trust Assets
scenes.line: It is a trust that holds investment assets purchased with a taxpayer's earned income. These assets are held for the taxpayer's eventual benefit in old age.
scenes.image_prompt: A metal vault door slightly ajar in a secure room., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Official Publication
scenes.line: An individual retirement account is a type of individual retirement arrangement as described in IRS Publication 590. Other arrangements include individual retirement annuities and employer-established benefit trusts.
scenes.image_prompt: A tax document resting on a wooden office desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Traditional Contributions
scenes.line: Traditional IRA contributions are mostly tax-deductible with money deposited before tax. No transactions within the IRA are taxed.
scenes.image_prompt: A person writing checks at a wooden kitchen table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Retirement Taxation
scenes.line: Withdrawals in retirement are taxed as income except for portions from non-deductible contributions. A traditional IRA may be a deductible IRA or a non-deductible IRA depending on the contribution.

scenes.label: ERISA Introduction

scenes.label: Self Directed IRA
scenes.line: Self-directed IRA custodians and administrators can allow real estate and other non-traditional assets held in forms other than a REIT, such as a piece of rental property, raw land, or fishing rights. scenes.label: Broker Restrictions
scenes.line: For example, some options brokers allow their IRA accounts to hold stock options, but others do not. Using certain derivatives or investments that involve leverage may be allowed by the IRC, it may also cause the IRA to pay taxes under the rules of Unrelated Business Income Tax.

scenes.label: Alternative Complexity
scenes.line: Self-directed IRAs which hold alternative investments such as real estate, horses, or intellectual property, can involve more complexity than IRAs which only hold stocks or mutual funds. scenes.label: Non Recourse Loan
scenes.line: Any loan on assets in the IRA would be required to be a non-recourse loan. The loan could not be personally secured by the IRA account owner, or the IRA itself, and it can only be secured by the asset in question.
scenes.image_prompt: Loan agreement document with a pen., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Pledge Prohibition
scenes.line: The owner of the IRA may not pledge the IRA as security against an outside debt. Although funds can be distributed from an IRA at any time, there are limited circumstances when money can be distributed or withdrawn from the account without penalties.
scenes.image_prompt: Padlock resting on financial papers., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Age Fifty Nine
scenes.line: Unless an exception applies, money can typically be withdrawn penalty-free as taxable income from an IRA once the owner reaches age 59 years and 6 months. Also, non-Roth owners must begin taking distributions of at least the calculated minimum amounts by April 1 of the year after reaching age 72.

scenes.label: RMD Penalty
scenes.line: If the required minimum distribution is not taken the penalty is 50% of the amount that should have been taken. The amount that must be taken is calculated based on a factor taken from the appropriate IRS table and is based on the life expectancy of the owner and possibly his or her spouse as beneficiary if applicable.
scenes.image_prompt: Red warning stamp on a paper document., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Charitable Distributions
scenes.line: Withdrawals are taxable unless paid to a charity after age 72, and this cutoff has changed over time while payments to charities are called Qualified Charitable Distributions. At the death of the owner, distributions must continue and if there is a designated beneficiary, distributions can be based on the life expectancy of the beneficiary.

scenes.label: Hardship Exemptions
scenes.line: There are several exceptions to the rule that penalties apply to distributions before age 591⁄2, and each exception has detailed rules that must be followed to be exempt from penalties. scenes.label: Unemployed Insurance

scenes.label: Beneficiary Distribution
scenes.line: Amounts distributed to beneficiaries of a deceased IRA owner qualify as an exception. Distributions in the form of an annuity are another exception to the early withdrawal penalties.
