scenes.label: Higher Education
scenes.line: Distributions that are not more than the qualified higher education expenses of the owner or their children or grandchildren are exempt. Distributions to buy, build, or rebuild a first home have a $10,000 lifetime maximum exception.
scenes.image_prompt: Graduation cap and diploma on a wooden table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: IRS Levy
scenes.line: Distribution due to an IRS levy of the plan is included in the penalty exceptions. For Roth IRAs with only contributed funds the basis can be withdrawn before age 59 without penalty or tax on a first in first out basis.

scenes.label: Roth Growth Penalty
scenes.line: A penalty would apply only on any growth, which is the taxable amount, that was taken out before 59 where an exception didn't apply. Amounts converted from a traditional to a Roth IRA must stay in the account for a minimum of 5 years to avoid having a penalty on withdrawal of basis unless one of the above exceptions applies.

scenes.label: Nondeductible Contributions
scenes.line: If the contribution to the IRA was nondeductible or the IRA owner chose not to claim a deduction, distributions of those nondeductible amounts are tax and penalty free. In the case of Rousey v. Jacoway, the United States Supreme Court ruled unanimously on April 4, 2005, that a debtor in bankruptcy can exempt an IRA up to the amount necessary for retirement from the bankruptcy estate.

scenes.label: Bankruptcy Protection
scenes.line: The Court indicated that because rights to withdrawals are based on age, IRAs should receive the same protection as other retirement plans. scenes.label: BAPCPA Act
scenes.line: The Bankruptcy Abuse Prevention and Consumer Protection Act of 2005 expanded the protection for IRAs. Certain IRAs like rollovers from SEP or Simple IRAs, Roth IRAs, and individual IRAs are exempt up to at least $1,000,000 adjusted periodically for inflation without having to show necessity for retirement.
scenes.image_prompt: Law books stacked on a shelf., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Interests of Justice

scenes.label: FDIC Insurance

scenes.label: California Statute

scenes.label: Defining Bank Runs
scenes.line: A bank run occurs when many clients withdraw their money from a bank. Clients withdraw funds because they believe the bank may fail in the near future.

scenes.label: Capital Flight

scenes.label: Default Probability

scenes.line: The score is calculated from several factors, but practically it analyzes a person's trajectory as a consumer, what includes up to date payments of bills, history of negative debts, financial relationships with companies and updated personal data on credit protection agencies, such as Serasa Experian, Boa Vista, SPC, Quod and Foregon. The system of credit reports and scores in Canada is very similar to that in the United States and India, with two of the same reporting agencies active in the country: Equifax and TransUnion.
scenes.image_prompt: A filing cabinet drawer partially open with folders inside., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Experian Canada
scenes.line: Experian, which entered the Canadian market with the purchase of Northern Credit Bureaus in 2008, announced the closing of its Canadian operations as of 18 April 2009. There are, however, some key differences.
scenes.image_prompt: An office building with mirrored glass windows., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Free Reports Canada
scenes.line: One is that, unlike in the United States, where a consumer is allowed only one free copy of their credit report a year, in Canada, the consumer may order a free copy of their credit report any number of times in a year, as long as the request is made in writing, and as long as the consumer asks for a printed copy to be delivered by mail. Borrowell and CreditKarma offers free credit report and credit check and this request by the consumer is noted in the credit report as a 'soft inquiry', so it has no effect on their credit score.
scenes.image_prompt: A stack of envelopes addressed and stamped on a table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: ScorePower Range
scenes.line: According to Equifax's ScorePower Report, Equifax Beacon scores range from 300 to 900. Trans Union Emperica scores also range from 300 to 900.
scenes.image_prompt: A digital meter graphic on a computer display., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Government Publication
scenes.line: The Government of Canada offers a free publication called Understanding Your Credit Report. This publication provides sample credit report and credit score documents, with explanations of the notations and codes that are used.
scenes.image_prompt: A government office reception desk with informational pamphlets., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: FCAC Resource
scenes.line: It also contains general information on how to build or improve credit history, and how to check for signs that identity theft has occurred. The publication is available online at the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada, and paper copies can also be ordered at no charge for residents of Canada.
scenes.image_prompt: A secure computer workstation setup in an office., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Private Systems
scenes.line: Private companies have developed credit score systems such as Sesame Credit (which is provided by Alibaba affiliate Ant Financial) and Tencent Credit. The credit scoring is widely used in Denmark by the banks and a number of private companies within telco and others.
scenes.image_prompt: A server room with rows of network hardware., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Two Way Split
scenes.line: The credit scoring is split in two: Private representing the probability of defaulting, and Businesses representing the probability of bankruptcy. For privates, the credit scoring is always made by the creditor, while for businesses it is either made by the creditor or by a third party.
scenes.image_prompt: A split screen graphic showing two different statistical charts., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Business Representation
scenes.line: A business credit score is a direct representation of a company's creditworthiness. There are a few companies who have specialized in developing credit scorecards in Denmark, including Experian for generic rating for business and Bisnode for generic rating for business.
scenes.image_prompt: A corporate building exterior viewed from street level., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Denmark Restrictions
scenes.line: The credit scorecards in Denmark are mainly based on information provided by the applicant and publicly available data, and it is very restricted by legislation compared to its neighbouring countries. In Germany, credit scoring is widely accepted as the primary method of assessing creditworthiness, used to determine credit approval, set credit limits, conduct behavioral modelling like collections scoring, and pre-approve additional credit.
scenes.image_prompt: A law book resting open on a wooden table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Indian credit firms
scenes.line: In India, there are four credit information companies licensed by Reserve Bank of India. The Credit Information Bureau India Limited has functioned as a Credit Information Company from January 2001.
scenes.image_prompt: Financial district buildings in a large city, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: New licenses issued
scenes.line: Subsequently, in 2010, Experian, Equifax and CRIF High Mark were given licenses by Reserve Bank of India. Transunion bought CIBIL.
scenes.image_prompt: Modern corporate office building exterior, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Popular score type
scenes.line: Although all the four credit information companies have developed their individual credit scores, the most popular is CIBIL credit score. The CIBIL credit score is a three digit number that represents a summary of individuals credit history and credit rating.
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of a calculator and financial charts, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Score range limits
scenes.line: This score ranges from 300 to 900, with 900 being the best score. Individuals with no credit history will have a score of minus 1.
scenes.image_prompt: Gauge graphic showing numbers from low to high, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Short history score
scenes.line: If the credit history is less than six months, the score will be 0. CIBIL credit score takes time to build up and usually it takes between 18 and 36 months or more.
scenes.image_prompt: Calendar pages flipping on an office desk, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Irish credit bureau
scenes.line: In Ireland, a person's credit score is calculated by the Irish Credit Bureau, a private organisation. The Irish Credit Bureau is financed by its members including financial institutions and local authorities.
scenes.image_prompt: Historic stone building facade in Dublin, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Loan data consent
scenes.line: A person taking out a loan must consent to their data being given to the Irish Credit Bureau. A person may receive their own credit report on paying a 6 euro fee to the Irish Credit Bureau.
scenes.image_prompt: Hand signing a document with a pen, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Irish score values
scenes.line: Credit scores run from 224, the worst value, to 581, the best value. There is also a separate Central Credit Register maintained by the Central Bank of Ireland.
scenes.image_prompt: Scale showing numerical values on a white background, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Register foundation
scenes.line: The Central Credit Register was founded in 2017 under the terms of the Credit Reporting Act 2013. The lender must check the Central Credit Register if a person is borrowing more than 2,000 euros.
scenes.image_prompt: Legal document open on a wooden table, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Consent exemption
scenes.line: The lender can also check the register if the loan is lower and consent from the borrower is not required. Information is removed from both registers five years after the loan is repaid.
scenes.image_prompt: Bank manager typing on a desktop keyboard, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Norwegian agencies
scenes.line: In Norway, credit scoring services are provided by three credit scoring agencies. Credit scoring is based on publicly available information such as demographic data, tax returns and taxable income.
scenes.image_prompt: Snowy street view in a Norwegian city, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Non-payment records
scenes.line: Non-payment records might be registered on the credit-scored individual in Norway. Upon being scored, an individual will receive a notice from the scoring agency.
scenes.image_prompt: Unpaid bill notice sitting on a kitchen counter, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Notice delivery
scenes.line: The notice is sent written or by e-mail stating who performed the credit score. Many credit institutions use custom scorecards based on any number of parameters.
scenes.image_prompt: Laptop computer screen showing an email inbox, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Norwegian score range
scenes.line: Credit scores range between 300 and 999. Credit scoring is used throughout the credit industry in South Africa.
scenes.image_prompt: Digital graph displaying numerical range, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Retail credit bureau
scenes.line: Currently all four retail credit bureau offer credit bureau scores. The data stored by the credit bureaus include both positive and negative data.
scenes.image_prompt: Office workers reviewing reports in a corporate setting, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Empirica score generation
scenes.line: TransUnion offer the Empirica Score which is in its 4th generation as of mid-2010. The Empirica score is segmented into two suites, the account origination and account management.
scenes.image_prompt: Server rack lights blinking in a data center, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Experian South Africa
scenes.line: Experian South Africa likewise has a Delphi credit score with their fourth generation about to be released. In 2011, Compuscan released Compuscore ABC, a scoring suite which predicts customer default.
scenes.image_prompt: Software developer working at a modern workstation, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Compuscore PSY introduction
scenes.line: Six years later, Compuscan introduced Compuscore PSY, a 3-digit psychometric-based credit bureau score. CRIB has been delegated with power to issue credit reports to any subject.
scenes.image_prompt: Psychometric test form on a wooden clipboard, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Self inquiry reports
scenes.line: The Bureau commenced to issue Self Inquiry Credit Reports in December 2009. Sweden has a system for credit scoring that aims to find people with a history of neglect to pay bills or taxes.
scenes.image_prompt: Person looking at a printed credit report at home, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Enforcement authority
scenes.line: Unpaid debts are forwarded to the Swedish Enforcement Authority. The appearance of a company as a debtor to this authority will result in a record among private credit bureaus.
scenes.image_prompt: Government office reception desk with a sign, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Record name and limits
scenes.line: This record is called a non-payment record and by law can be stored for three years for an individual. The non-payment record can be stored for five years for a company.
scenes.image_prompt: Calendar marking three years passing, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Record consequences
scenes.line: This kind of nonpayment record will make it very difficult to get a loan or rent an apartment. The record affects getting a job that involves handling cash.
scenes.image_prompt: Keys resting on top of a rental lease agreement, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Income assessments
scenes.line: The banks also use income and asset figures in connection with loan assessments. If a person gets an injunction to pay issued by the Enforcement Authority, it is possible to dispute it.
scenes.image_prompt: Bank loan officer reviewing financial statements, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: District court trial
scenes.line: Then the party requesting the payment must show its correctness in district court. Swedish astronaut Christer Fuglesang got a non-payment record since a car passed a toll station.
scenes.image_prompt: Courtroom interior with rows of wooden seating, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Record permanence
scenes.line: The case was appealed and retracted, but the non-payment record remained for three years. Credit scoring in the United Kingdom is very different to that of the United States and other nations.
scenes.image_prompt: Official legal document stamped with a red seal, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: UK lender criteria
scenes.line: Each lender will assess potential borrowers on their own criteria. The most popular statistical technique used is logistic regression to predict a binary outcome.
scenes.image_prompt: Financial analyst reviewing data models on a laptop, minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Consumer uncertainty
scenes.line: It is very difficult for a consumer to know in advance whether they have a high enough credit score to be accepted for credit. Lenders need not reveal their credit score head, nor need they reveal the minimum credit score required for the applicant to be accepted.
scenes.image_prompt: A person looking thoughtfully at a computer screen in a home office., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Reason omission
scenes.line: If the applicant is declined for credit, the lender is not obliged to reveal the exact reason why. Industry associations including the Finance and Leasing Association oblige their members to provide a satisfactory reason.
scenes.image_prompt: A rejection letter resting on a wooden desk next to a pen., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Bureau data
scenes.line: Credit bureau data sharing agreements also require that an applicant declined based on credit bureau data be told that this is the reason. In the United States, a credit score is a number based on a statistical analysis of a person's credit files.
scenes.image_prompt: A stack of business reports and documents neatly arranged on a table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Creditworthiness definition
scenes.line: The score represents the creditworthiness of that person, which is the likelihood that people will pay their bills. A credit score is primarily based on credit report information, typically from Experian, TransUnion, and Equifax.
scenes.image_prompt: A calendar hanging on a wall next to a desk lamp., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Excluded factors
scenes.line: Income and employment history are not considered by the major credit bureaus when calculating credit scores. FICO scores are a credit score developed by FICO, previously known as Fair Isaac Corporation.
scenes.image_prompt: A payslip resting beside a computer keyboard on an office desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Version count
scenes.line: As of 2018, there were 29 different versions of FICO scores in use in the United States. Some of these versions are industry specific scores produced for particular market segments, including automotive lending and bankcard lending.
scenes.image_prompt: A software interface displaying version numbers and data lists., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Automotive versus bankcard
scenes.line: Industry-specific FICO scores produced for automotive lending are formulated differently than FICO scores produced for bankcard lending. Nearly every consumer will have different FICO scores depending upon which type of FICO score is ordered by a lender.
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of a car steering wheel with a dashboard in the background., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Loan example
scenes.line: For example, a consumer with several paid-in-full car loans will generally score better on an automotive-enhanced score. FICO also produces several general purpose scores which are not tailored to any particular industry.
scenes.image_prompt: A set of car keys lying on a wooden tabletop near a window., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Score ranges
scenes.line: Industry-specific FICO scores range from 250 to 900, whereas general purpose scores range from 300 to 850. FICO scores are used by many mortgage lenders that use a risk-based system to determine the possibility of default.
scenes.image_prompt: A digital thermometer display showing numbers in a room., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Three mortgage scores
scenes.line: For most mortgages originated in the United States, three credit scores are obtained on a consumer. A Beacon 5.0 score is calculated from the consumer's Equifax credit history.
scenes.image_prompt: Three official documents stacked together on a glass table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: FICO Model II
scenes.line: A FICO Model II score is calculated from the consumer's Experian credit history. A Classic04 score is calculated from the consumer's Trans Union history.
scenes.image_prompt: A desk with an open laptop showing graphs and financial statistics., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Direct purchase
scenes.line: Credit bureaus also often re-sell FICO scores directly to consumers, often a general-purpose FICO 8 score. Previously, the credit bureaus also sold their own credit scores which they developed themselves.
scenes.image_prompt: A credit card lying on a desk next to an open ledger book., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Discontinued scores
scenes.line: As of 2018, Equifax's RISK score and Experian's PLUS score are no longer sold by the credit bureaus. Trans Union offers a Vantage 3.0 score for sale to consumers, which is a version of the VantageScore credit score.
scenes.image_prompt: An empty shelf in a modern office archive room., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Proprietary models
scenes.line: Many large lenders, including major credit card issuers, have developed their own proprietary scoring models. Studies have shown scores to be predictive of risk in the underwriting of both credit and insurance.
scenes.image_prompt: Server racks humming inside a brightly lit technology room., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Consumer benefits
scenes.line: Some studies suggest that most consumers are the beneficiaries of lower credit costs and insurance premiums. Usage of credit histories in employment screenings increased from 19% in 1996 to 42% in 2006.
scenes.image_prompt: A piggy bank sitting on a wooden table next to some coins., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Report exclusion
scenes.line: Credit reports for employment screening purposes do not include credit scores. Americans are entitled to one free credit report in every 12-month period from each of the three credit bureaus.
scenes.image_prompt: A printed resume lying on a clean wooden office table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Annual credit report
scenes.line: The three credit bureaus run Annualcreditreport.com, where users can get their free credit reports. Credit scores are available as an add-on feature of the report for a fee.
scenes.image_prompt: A laptop open on a table displaying a simple web browser page., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Investigation timeline
scenes.line: If the consumer disputes an item, under the Fair Credit Reporting Act, credit bureaus have 45 days to investigate. Consumers wishing to obtain their credit scores can purchase them separately or from FICO directly.
scenes.image_prompt: A wall clock ticking in a quiet professional office workspace., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Subscription monitoring
scenes.line: Credit scores are also made available free by subscription to credit report monitoring services. To get scores free from most monitoring services, one must use a credit card to sign up for a free trial.
scenes.image_prompt: A tablet screen displaying a security lock icon on the display., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Free alternatives
scenes.line: Websites like WalletHub, Credit Sesame and Credit Karma provide free credit scores with no credit card required. Free scores provided by WalletHub, Credit Sesame and Credit Karma use the TransUnion VantageScore 3.0 model.
scenes.image_prompt: A smartphone resting on a wooden desk next to a coffee cup., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Experian model
scenes.line: Credit.com uses the Experian VantageScore 3.0 model to provide scores to consumers. Until March 2009, holders of cards issued by Washington Mutual were offered a free FICO score each month.
scenes.image_prompt: A computer keyboard and mouse positioned on a clean white desk., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Chase acquisition
scenes.line: Chase, which took over Washington Mutual in 2008, discontinued this practice in March 2009. Chase resumed the practice of offering a free FICO score in March 2010 to select card members.
scenes.image_prompt: A closed glass doorway of a commercial bank building., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Adverse action rule
scenes.line: Under the Fair Credit Reporting Act, a consumer is entitled to a free credit report within 60 days of any adverse action. Under the Wall Street reform bill passed on 22 July 2010, a consumer is entitled to receive a free credit score if denied.
scenes.image_prompt: A legal document resting on a dark wooden table surface., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Median scores
scenes.line: In the United States, the median generic FICO score was 723 in 2006 and 711 in 2011. The performance definition of the FICO risk score is to predict the likelihood of going 90 days past due.
scenes.image_prompt: A statistical bar chart displayed on a computer monitor screen., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Prediction window
scenes.line: The score predicts past due status in the subsequent 24 months after the score has been calculated. Because different lending uses have different parameters, FICO algorithms are adjusted according to predictability.
scenes.image_prompt: A wall clock mounted in a brightly lit corporate office room., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic

scenes.label: Score comparison
scenes.line: A person might have a higher credit score for revolving debt when compared to a mortgage credit score. The higher the consumer's score, the less likely he or she will go 90 days past due in the subsequent months.
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of two digital scales balancing weights on a table., minimalist flat vector illustration, clean modern financial infographics, dark slate and emerald green color palette, professional aesthetic
